prompt: Abeg, wetin be the time wey polling unit dey open and close for election day?
response: Section 46(1) of di Electoral Act, 2026 dey talk say di Presiding Officer go open di ballot box or present di voting device for di hour wey dem fix for opening di poll, before accreditation and voting start. Di ballot box go stay open and visible to all di people until di poll close.
